title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
summary: A landmark 3D action-adventure and one of the most collected Nintendo 64 games.
tradeNotes: Version, label condition, manual, box, inserts, and gold cartridge variants can change value significantly.

title: Super Mario 64
summary: Nintendo's genre-defining 3D platformer and a core N64 library piece.
tradeNotes: Collectors care about label wear, cartridge shell condition, box/manuals, and early print details.

title: Pokemon Red Version
summary: One of the original Game Boy Pokemon RPGs that helped launch the franchise globally.
tradeNotes: Battery save status, label condition, authenticity, box/manuals, and region are important.

title: Pokemon Blue Version
summary: The companion release to Pokemon Red and one of the most recognizable handheld RPGs.
tradeNotes: Verify authenticity, save battery, label quality, cartridge shell, and included manual or box.

title: Pokemon Yellow Version
summary: The Pikachu-focused special edition of the first Pokemon generation.
tradeNotes: High bootleg risk; check board/authenticity photos, battery, label, and box/manuals.

title: Chrono Trigger
summary: A beloved Super Nintendo RPG with consistently strong collector demand.
tradeNotes: Complete-in-box copies command a premium; inspect label, board authenticity, manual, map/posters, and box wear.

title: EarthBound
summary: A cult-favorite RPG and one of the most valuable mainstream SNES collector targets.
tradeNotes: Authenticity, label quality, guide/booklet, oversized box, and inserts are major value factors.

title: Final Fantasy VII
summary: A defining PlayStation RPG with broad player and collector recognition.
tradeNotes: Check disc scratches, black-label versus greatest-hits release, manual, case cracks, and all discs.

title: Metal Gear Solid
summary: A cinematic stealth-action landmark and a PlayStation collection essential.
tradeNotes: Verify both discs, manual, case art, black-label status, and disc condition.

title: Silent Hill 2
summary: A revered survival-horror game with strong collector demand across versions.
tradeNotes: Platform, edition, manual, disc condition, case art, and soundtrack/bonus content affect value.

title: Resident Evil 4
summary: A landmark action-horror release with popular GameCube and PS2 physical versions.
tradeNotes: GameCube black-label copies, manuals, disc condition, and variant editions are worth noting.

title: Super Smash Bros. Melee
summary: A GameCube essential with long-running competitive and collector demand.
tradeNotes: Disc condition, black-label case, manual, and bundle with controllers can increase value.

title: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker
summary: A beloved cel-shaded Zelda adventure and a major GameCube collector title.
tradeNotes: Check disc condition, case/manual, black-label versus player's choice, and bonus disc variants.

title: Halo: Combat Evolved
summary: The original Xbox's defining launch shooter and a core library title.
tradeNotes: Black-label copies, manual, disc condition, and console bundles are relevant.

title: Halo 3
summary: A major Xbox 360 release with regular demand from nostalgic players and collectors.
tradeNotes: Standard, limited, and legendary editions should be listed separately with all inserts and condition notes.

title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim
summary: A long-running open-world RPG with many physical editions and re-releases.
tradeNotes: Platform, edition, map insert, steelbook, DLC inclusion, and Switch cartridge version matter.

title: Grand Theft Auto V
summary: One of the most widely played open-world games with active demand across generations.
tradeNotes: Platform, edition, map/poster, disc condition, and upgrade/version details matter.

title: The Last of Us
summary: A major PlayStation story-driven game with demand boosted by remasters and screen adaptation.
tradeNotes: Platform, remastered/part I version, steelbook, special editions, and disc condition matter.

title: God of War
summary: A major PlayStation action-adventure revival with strong franchise recognition.
tradeNotes: Collector editions, steelbooks, art books, and complete inserts are important.

title: Elden Ring
summary: A major open-world action RPG with strong demand across platforms.
tradeNotes: Platform, launch edition, steelbook, collector statue, map, and DLC bundle status affect value.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
summary: A defining open-world Zelda release and long-running Switch collection staple.
tradeNotes: Switch vs Wii U version, case, cartridge label, special edition box, and map/soundtrack matter.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
summary: The sequel to Breath of the Wild and a major Switch-era Nintendo release.
tradeNotes: Collector's edition contents, case, cartridge, art book, steel poster, and pins should be listed.

title: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe
summary: A long-running Switch evergreen with broad family and multiplayer demand.
tradeNotes: Case/cartridge condition and bundle inclusion with Switch consoles matter.

title: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
summary: A massive Switch life-sim release with broad casual and collector demand.
tradeNotes: Popular in console bundles; case, cartridge, and themed hardware bundles should be documented.

title: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate
summary: The flagship Switch Smash release and a reliable multiplayer seller.
tradeNotes: Case/cartridge, DLC bundle status, controller bundles, and special editions matter.

title: Pokemon Scarlet
summary: One of the ninth-generation Pokemon RPGs for Nintendo Switch.
tradeNotes: Case/cartridge condition, DLC bundle release, double packs, and steelbooks are useful listing details.

title: Pokemon Violet
summary: The companion release to Pokemon Scarlet with strong Switch demand.
tradeNotes: Double packs, DLC bundle editions, steelbooks, case, and cartridge condition matter.

title: Minecraft
summary: A cross-platform sandbox giant with broad ongoing demand.
tradeNotes: Platform, edition, physical case/cartridge/disc, and bundle inclusion matter.

title: Fortnite
summary: A major live-service game with cultural reach and collectible physical bundles.
tradeNotes: Most value is in hardware bundles, sealed physical releases, codes, and promo items; be careful with account/code sales.

title: Counter-Strike 2
summary: Valve's current competitive tactical shooter and one of PC gaming's major live titles.
tradeNotes: Avoid account trading; future marketplace data should focus on physical merch, peripherals, and sealed legacy releases.

title: Helldivers 2
summary: A popular co-op shooter with active community demand.
tradeNotes: Physical PS5 copies, special editions, and bundled merch should be listed clearly.

title: Marvel Rivals
summary: A Marvel team-based hero shooter with strong streaming and community interest.
tradeNotes: Avoid account trading; focus future listings on physical merch, collector items, and platform bundles.

title: Grand Theft Auto VI
summary: Rockstar's highly anticipated next Grand Theft Auto release.
tradeNotes: Track platform editions, preorder bonuses, collector editions, and sealed physical copy demand.
